question.text: A company issues a public debt offering with a base issue size of Rs. 150 crore. What is the maximum total amount the company can raise including oversubscription retention (without shelf prospectus)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.227-p.228, oversubscription up to 100% of the base issue size can be retained. So the maximum total = Base issue (Rs. 150 crore) + Oversubscription retention (100% of Rs. 150 crore = Rs. 150 crore) = Rs. 300 crore. The Trap: Rs. 225 crore assumes only 50% oversubscription retention, and Rs. 375 crore assumes 150% retention — neither matches the SEBI ILDS rule. Note: The 100% oversubscription retention cap applies in addition to the base issue size for a public issue of debt securities.
